response.overview: A profound 37-episode musical journey carved through 10 years of silence and solitude. ❤️ This soul-stirring saga transcends mortal love into pure spiritual devotion. A majestic testament to eternal connection, healing lonely souls with divine music and an ultimate vision of peace for a billion hearts worldwide. ✨
response.tagline: 👉 A 10-year silent journey dedicated to lonely souls.
response.title: Ruhani Safar
